offers: Day trip, staycation up to 10 days
notes: No appointment or application. Bring ID, sign a waiver. Daycations 11am-5pm weekdays and 9am-3pm weekends, only when no adopters are waiting. Staycations up to 10 days. Open to anyone, any county.
Book with the online scheduler (Saturdays online only; limited weekday walk-ins). Pickups 10am-3pm, return by 5pm weekdays or 4:30pm Saturdays. Ask about turning it into a sleepover.
Reserve a pickup slot online. Tue-Fri pickups 9:30am or 1:30pm (back by 3:30pm); Saturday pickups 9:30am or 11:30am (back by 1pm). Fill out a pet report card afterward.

program: Dog Day Out / Paws Across Alamance
notes: Schedule a day and time Monday-Friday (until 4:30pm) to take a dog hiking on Alamance County trails. Monthly group Hikes with Hounds for volunteers too.
Reported to require a foster application, then booking a date and time on the shelter calendar.
Email at least 72 hours ahead with dates, pickup and drop-off times and destinations.

org: LifeLine Animal Project (DeKalb County Animal Services & Community Animal Center)
notes: Ages 18+. Book a Dog for the Day pickup online for the shelter you want. Leash, harness and adopt-me vest provided. No dog parks. Fulton County location listed as currently unavailable.

org: Lollypop Farm (Humane Society of Greater Rochester)
notes: Take a dog out for a few hours during adoption hours. Quick sign-up form at the Fairport shelter, 99 Victor Road.
Stop by the SoHo center at 307 West Broadway, meet available dogs and head out on an adventure. Program has paused at times; confirm before going.
Take a dog out for a few hours, a full day or overnight. Backpack of supplies provided; fill out a report card afterward.
Reported to run Wednesdays, Saturdays and Sundays: check a dog out 10-10:30am with a valid ID (18+), return by 4pm. No sign-up ahead.
Volunteers take longer-stay dogs to trails, wineries and coffee shops several days a week.
Check out a shelter dog for a few hours or a full day; slumber-party sleepovers also offered.
Doggie field trip program that has run as events and as an ongoing volunteer option.
Volunteer program. Need a vehicle where the dog can be safely tethered inside (tethers provided).
Adults with a valid driver's license fill out a questionnaire and take a designated dog out for a few hours up to a day.
Approved participants take an adoptable dog off-site with a backpack of supplies and a list of dog-friendly spots. Reported to run seven days a week.
Award-winning program to take a shelter dog out for a day of adventure; started as a volunteer and foster program.
Volunteers and fosters pick up a dog from the Sam Swope Pet Retreat for a park outing, dog-friendly business or afternoon at home.
